<title level="1" right="Class Feature 9">[Gunslinger Expertise](/Classes.aspx?ID=20)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Guns & Gears (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=98) pg. 105

**Class** Gunslinger
</column>

---

Your special shots become harder for opponents to predict or resist. Your proficiency rank for your gunslinger class DC increases to expert.
name: Gunslinger Expertise
